title: Static Generation of Efficient OpenMP Offload Data Mappings
problem: OpenMP programs on heterogeneous devices require explicit data mapping between host and accelerators, which demands complex reasoning about data dependencies and validity across multiple environments, making it error-prone for programmers.
motivation: Efficient data movement is crucial for achieving high utilization on heterogeneous HPC architectures where data transfer overhead can significantly impact performance.
method: OMPDart performs static analysis to model data dependencies between host and device regions in OpenMP programs. It automatically applies source code transformations to generate efficient data mapping constructs. The tool is evaluated on nine HPC benchmarks to demonstrate effectiveness in reducing host-device data transfers.
key_novelty: Automated static analysis approach to generate optimal OpenMP data mapping directives without manual programmer intervention.
contributions: Static analysis tool (OMPDart) that models data dependencies in OpenMP heterogeneous computing programs
Automatic source code transformations to generate efficient data mapping constructs
Demonstration of substantial host-device data transfer reduction on HPC benchmarks

metrics.other: data transfer volume reduction between host and device

primary_theme: automated data mapping optimization for OpenMP GPU offloading
